exact_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: text-free three-panel vertical continuity strip for CH03 CH03-S04 group 1
Input images: Image 1 is the registered clean-cinematic style anchor; Image 2 is the registered Sola progression sheet when Sola appears; Image 3 is the registered supporting-adult sheet when Tarin, Kesin, or Serac appears. Use only for original identity, wardrobe state, contour, palette, and equipment continuity.
Primary request: Create one portrait canvas divided into exactly three stacked chronological comic frames with clean narrow gutters. Each frame is a distinct story moment, not a montage.
Scene/backdrop: roofline overlooking stabilized Lower Crescent at sunset in Caelune, an original city of pearl-stone crescent districts suspended above a deep blue cloud sea by living luminous roads.
Characters: Sola Merrow, fictional adult woman age 38, tall athletic working build and mature proportions, warm brown skin, long dark auburn hair in a low segmented braid with one silver forelock, deep navy practical pathwright coat with ivory piping, ochre scarf, slate trousers and boots; copper oath bracer until broken; never sexualized; Tarin Kest, fictional adult man age 45, broad mature build, deep umber skin, short tightly curled black hair silver at both temples, pearl-gray practical warden coat over muted teal layers, dark trousers and boots; long ivory spear-key until broken; never sexualized; Kesin Or, fictional adult nonbinary archivist age 52, compact mature build, light olive skin, shaved head, round amber spectacles, plum-gray layered archive jacket, ink-dark gloves and satchel; never sexualized; Serac Dain, fictional adult man age 51, lean mature build, pale bronze skin, swept-back charcoal hair with a white central streak, immaculate ivory magistrate coat with restrained black geometry and mirrored oath gauntlet; never sexualized.
Non-human subjects: none.
Style/medium: original clean cinematic fantasy-webtoon illustration; crisp controlled dark-navy contours; limited internal linework; smooth cel shading with restrained painterly gradients; clean skin, hair, fabric, stone and metal shapes; mature adult proportions; strong foreground/midground/background value separation; pearl stone, midnight blue and cool cyan with selective warm gold oathlight; generous negative space; one dominant focal subject; restrained luminous accents; emotionally legible faces; no texture fog.
Composition/framing: top-to-bottom chronology; one dominant focal subject and no more than two competing actions per frame; simple low-detail backgrounds except when the frame establishes geography; large readable gestures and silhouettes; naturally quiet open areas, but never draw a box for text.
Chronological frames:
Frame 1: Establish roofline overlooking stabilized Lower Crescent at sunset with sola, tarin, kesin, serac; make current geography and emotional condition immediately legible.
Frame 2: Concrete objective: Trace the foreign pulse fighting Sola's new Hold chord; show an adult initiating a specific next step.
Frame 3: Escalation becomes visible: A distant figure draws light out of an abandoned bridge with a mirrored gauntlet.
Irreversible visible state already in force: tarin_admits_warden_oath_broken, sola_trusts_oathpulse_evidence, sola_first_witness_line, sola_bound_to_stay_until_crossing_complete, sola_first_oath_completed, tarin_badge_cracked, tarin_public_duty_over_command, sola_unlocks_listen_chord, sola_oathnoise_fatigue, tarin_badge_surrendered, sola_tarin_kesin_declared_obstructors, sola_rejects_defensive_bureaucracy, sola_unlocks_hold_chord, sola_career_pledged_to_truthful_repair.
New state introduced by this sequence and visible when causally reached: serac_identified_as_oath_thief, abandoned_bridge_severed, serac_knows_sola_can_listen.
Constraints: all humans are explicitly fictional adults with unmistakably mature proportions; preserve named identity, hair, clothing, injury, equipment, and relationship state; coherent hands and anatomy; clear cause and effect; disciplined light; at most one cyan-gold oath effect per frame; source art contains no final lettering.
Avoid: any text, letters, numbers, captions, speech balloons, empty caption rectangles, blank placards, logos, signatures, watermarks, floating interface, children, child-coded or young-looking adults, sexualized clothing or framing, real-person likeness, third-party characters, title-specific designs, named-artist imitation, woodcut marks, dry brush, risograph, paper grain, hatching, crosshatching, grunge, muddy palette, equal detail everywhere, crowded machinery, multiple competing effects, generic glossy 3D.
